correctness.rationale: For friendship graph F_m (m>=2), exactly (m+1)2^m matchings; all indicator vectors are vertices, full dimension 3m including empty and singleton matchings. Direct joint inclusion counting gives block covariance AA=I/4-J/[4(m+1)^2], BB=I/[2(m+1)]-J/[4(m+1)^2], AB=J/[4(m+1)^2]-H/[4(m+1)]. Antisymmetric spoke vectors have eigenvalue q=1/[2(m+1)], contrast block C_m and uniform block U_m have two eigenvalues each. Algebraic determinants/interlacing prove 0<U-<C-<q<U+<C+ and condition ratio ~m^2/2 for every m>=2. Independent brute force matchings m=2,3,4 and full covariance diagonalization reproduced all eigenvalues with correct multiplicities; algebra establishes infinite family.

The complete-graph matching covariance theorem has a different graph and three modes, while the present windmill has five strict modes and quadratic anisotropy. General monomer-dimer partition functions give moments but do not directly supply this full decomposition.
